summary: The WelcomeDC file is part of a web application providing a user interface for managing destination coordinators. It contains various user controls, tabs, and panels for handling reports, messages, supervisors, and destinations.
purpose: To facilitate navigation and management within the web application, providing structured access to various features and controls related to destination coordination.

fields.name: cmdHideErrorPanel
fields.description: Button to hide the error panel.

fields.name: cmdHideWarningPanel
fields.description: Button to hide the warning panel.

workflows.name: Report Navigation
steps: User clicks on a report tab.
The application checks which report is selected.
Loads corresponding data and makes the respective panel visible.

workflows.name: Error Handling
steps: User clicks 'Hide' button to dismiss the error panel.

business_rules: Ensure the user session is authenticated before loading the page.
Only show links and panels if the user has appropriate permissions.

validations.name: checkOtherReasonNotes
validations.description: Validates that notes are provided when 'Other' reason code is selected.

validations.name: checkStartEnd
validations.description: Ensures the start date is earlier than or equal to the end date.

conditions: If MultiViewReports.ActiveViewIndex is 0, LoadDestPlcSchedule is called.
If MultiViewReports.ActiveViewIndex is 1, LoadStaffListDC is called.
system_behavior: Panels are only visible when their corresponding tab is active.
System uses client-side scripts for interactive elements like date resetting.
dependencies: UserSession object for maintaining user state and permissions.
AjaxControlToolkit for UI components like TabPanel.
exceptions: Redirect to default page if UserSession is null during logout.
